earned_findings: One compact shadow schema represents user, assistant, joint, and unclear ownership without changing the runtime IR.
Thread disposition distinguishes open-unaddressed, addressed-unresolved, resolved, superseded, genuinely dropped, and unclear states.
Source-strength modes preserve stated, reported, possible, preferred, concerned, inferred, and mixed language.
Five reviewed development packets carry 5 joint positions, 5 corrected thread dispositions, 43 constraints, and 88 exact source references.
Every case-local item is graph-ineligible and all fact-free routing projections contain zero direct graph seeds.
The complete non-network suite passed: 4086 passed, 1 skipped, 93 subtests passed.
limitations: The five packets were reviewed in the same project session and are not independent gold labels.
No production model populated the new schema.
The 53 state items are an audit and navigation inventory, not a context packet for the fresh reasoner.
No reasoning-pattern abstraction, graph value, consumer effect, or answer improvement was measured.

prospective_probe_boundary.case_selection_goal: one resolved-thread case and one addressed-unresolved case with material source-strength risk
required_pre_call_freeze: case IDs and exact source hashes
one prompt and typed response schema
model, temperature, output cap, and timeout
source-first scoring axes and stop rules
prospective_probe_boundary.pass_boundary: Both outputs must preserve ownership and thread disposition and must not materially regress constraint coverage, source-strength calibration, exact quote grounding, or late-turn trajectory.
prospective_probe_boundary.failure_boundary: Any schema failure, provider failure, false dropped-thread classification, material source strengthening, or meaningful coverage regression stops the probe without retry or full-pipeline escalation.

next_goal: Freeze and dry-run the two-case extraction-only probe contract; do not execute calls until every pre-call boundary passes.
